title: Understanding Batch Gradient Descent
text: Batch gradient descent uses the entire dataset to compute the gradient of the cost function. This can lead to oscillations around the minimum point, especially if the learning rate is not set appropriately.

title: Characteristics of Batch Gradient Descent
text: In batch gradient descent, the updates to the parameters are made after computing the gradient using all the training examples. This can cause the updates to overshoot the minimum if the learning rate is too high.
